description: Segments of a non-ARQ C_PDU that do not fit the first transmission go in the next one with the same C_PDU ID and cut, and the first segment's reception window covers that transmission.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ and sends "segment-me-now" (priority 0, TTL 0, no retransmissions). dts.max_segment_size 8 cuts the 20-byte C_PDU into 8, 8 and 4 bytes, C_PDU ID 0 (C-0527, C-0529, C-0549): D_PDUs of 32, 32 and 28 bytes (address size 3, C-0133). dts.max_transmission_ms 5550 allows one 63-byte block, and csma.num_cont_slots 1 makes the contention wait 0 (K-0080). First transmission at 30000: segment 0 fits and segment 1 does not (64 bytes), so the class stops and the rest wait (C-0880, C-0542). EOT 10. The two unsent segments (60 bytes) need one more transmission, so n = 1 and the reception window is ceil((4950 + 11550) / 500) = 33, committing to 30000 + 600 + 16500 = 47100 (C-1051, C-1052). Second transmission at 38550 (lbt_wait_vdcd_ms after the own transmission, K-0074) ends 44100, inside 47100: segments 1 and 2, offsets 8 and 16, same ID and cut, both in block 0, EOT and window 10 (C-0350). It empties the queue, so dts.ttd is cancelled first (C-1050).
